pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular, multi-sided geometry with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Flank patches possess a larger relative spatial area than the more compressed, elongated patches visible on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous negative-space graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent. The pixel thickness of these corridors is non-uniform, narrowing noticeably on the upper neck compared to the broader pathways on the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a short, dense, dark silhouette along the neck with high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness against the sky background.
